messages:
Rowan (Marketing): hey team — new ask for the Orbit launch: compact benchmark asset suite. Needed deliverables: hero benchmark diagram (web + print), 2 webinar slides (context + results), single-page PDF one-pager, 4 social tiles (2x square, 2x story), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map for HubSpot. Go-live target: Tue EOD (2026-04-07). who can take ownership and any blockers?

Maya (Design): I can handle. Quick clarifications: which metrics to call out? do we have official brand-approved headlines and any customer logos to include? file export specs?

Rowan (Marketing): prioritize latency p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. Short headline strings only — will drop final copy to Drive. Logos: only from Legal-approved whitelist. Specs: hero web PNG 1400x800, hero print PDF 8.5x11, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920, email header 600x200, SVG must include element ids for HubSpot mapping.

Ethan (Product): uploaded benchmark sheet to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-orbit-bench (CSV + notes). Key numbers: p50=38ms, p95=110ms, gen cost=$0.0065/1k tokens. Added testbed note: "measured on internal testbed; not an SLA".

Kira (Growth): short social copy options: "Serving wins: faster, cheaper" / "Benchmarked: 38ms p50, 110ms p95". CTAs: "Register" / "See the benchpack". I'll prepare 1-line variants for EN/FR/DE.

Ops (Marketing Ops): for the SVG inbound map please include ids like id=form-email id=segment-webinar id=sfdc-source so I can map fields. I'll provide a mapping CSV once svg ids exist. Example mapping format: FormField,Segment,SFDC_Field
email,Inbound - Orbit,Email
company,Inbound - Orbit,Company
interest,Orbit Bench,Bench_Product_Interest__c

Legal (Legal): compliance note: do not use customer logos without explicit written approval. Partner logos on the whitelist are fine. Also avoid definitive claims; use wording such as "benchmarked" or "measured in our testbeds." Ethan, keep that README text in the Drive folder.

Maya (Design): timeline: WIP on Mon morning (09:00 PT) — hero + webinar slides first. Final deliverables Tue afternoon. I'll export EN masters with editable text layers for localization. Will attach SVG with element ids and provide a versioned filename list (e.g., orbit-hero-web.png, orbit-webinar-slide1.pdf, orbit-routing.svg).

Rowan (Marketing): ordering priority: 1) hero + slides 2) routing SVG 3) 1-pager 4) social + email header. Please flag any delays ASAP.

Maya (Design): noted. WIP link (figma): https://www.figma.com/file/ORBIT/benchpack-wip (comment-only). Tagging @Rowan when WIP is ready.

Ethan (Product): added README line to Drive per Legal request.

Kira (Growth): I'll drop the short translated strings to the Drive by EOD today.

Rowan (Marketing): thanks all — will run a quick brand-compliance sweep on WIP and loop Legal if needed. :thumbsup:

Maya (Design): got it. Will upload final exports to the shared Drive and ping this thread.
